subject.title: [Feature]: Discord self-profile updates (strict bot-only scope for nickname/avatar/status)

question: Should OpenClaw add a bundled Discord `self-profile` mutation action for bot nickname/avatar/status changes, and what exact gate/self-only/account/audit contract should it use?
rationale: The request would add a new external identity-mutation capability and config gate, and automation cannot choose the security boundary or product API without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep open for sponsored design
options.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer approves the Discord plugin API, default-off gate, self-only checks, account behavior, avatar validation, and proof requirements.

options.title: Presence-only scope
options.body: Treat the shipped `set-presence` and `autoPresence` behavior as the accepted scope and decline nickname/avatar mutation for now.

options.title: External plugin/API discussion
options.body: Require a narrower plugin API extension or external plugin proposal before adding bundled self-profile mutation to OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Keep open for sponsored design
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open until a maintainer approves the Discord plugin API, default-off gate, self-only checks, account behavior, avatar validation, and proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main history points to this owner for the Discord plugin action/config surface, and the decision is about whether to expand that surface.
